The PROCEED verdict at 62% confidence was mathematically justified by calm_bull base rates (72% continuation) but operationally reckless: the debate explicitly quantified portfolio concavity (-7.7% regime-flip impact), identified BAX as a deteriorating -33.9% momentum drag at 7.5% weight, and flagged systemic correlation collapse (19→14 independent bets under stress), yet the judge suppressed action citing the 2026-06-15 false alarm about over-caution.
